entries.question: Fold #5929 and #7565 (same root cause as #7553: the front phase never advances the run, so fall-throughs land on the DAG at discovery)?
entries.rationale: Operator ruling 2026-11-12: one root-cause fix closes #7553, #5929, #7565. #5797/#4898/#5670/#3932/#5112 Refs only.

entries.question: Envelope of an advancing next once the WP board is finished (all approved/done)?
entries.rationale: Operator ruling 2026-11-12: kind=blocked with an error_code and remediation naming the next CLI command; records no step row and does not advance the run.

entries.question: #7582: rejection/reopen subtask reset policy?
entries.rationale: Operator ruling 2026-11-12: keep full reset as default (#2513 protection), record it with the completed set and reason on the PLANNED transition, add move-task --reset-subtasks narrowing (operator reason required).

entries.question: #7553: must a kind=query envelope always carry a question?
entries.rationale: Operator leans 'must ask a question'; a research squad is dispatched to corroborate or disprove before the ruling is final.

entries.question: Final: query envelope question contract (supersedes the 'pending research squad' entry for query_question)
entries.rationale: Operator ruling 2026-11-12 after a two-lens research squad (consumer + history) DISPROVED 'query always carries a question'. Keep question nullable; pin invariant question!=null iff decision_id and options present; fix the drop for a first decision_required; add an additive defaulted next_command to every non-decision query envelope; amend #7553 wording in the PR.

entries.question: Per-state mapping of the blocked-with-remedy ruling
entries.rationale: Operator ruling 2026-11-12: board finished and not accepted -> kind=blocked, new error_code MISSION_AWAITING_ACCEPTANCE, remediation spec-kitty accept; accepted (board still finished) or landed -> existing kind=terminal. No step row recorded, run not advanced. No-WP and research/custom missions unchanged.

entries.question: Widen the gate to the mid-implementation replay (#5929 comment 2)?
entries.rationale: Operator ruling 2026-11-12 after post-tasks squad: for software-dev, when a finalized WP board exists and names a step but dispatch declines, advancing next returns blocked naming the board state; never issues a DAG step before the board step; records nothing. Closes #5929 fully.

entries.question: FR-010 invariant restatement
entries.rationale: Operator ruling 2026-11-12: question non-null iff decision_id non-null; when set, options or input_key present. Enforce by construction: split the pending-decision fields into a validated value object so invalid envelopes cannot be created.

entries.question: What counts as accepted?
entries.rationale: Operator ruling 2026-11-12: accepted only when accepted_at is later than the board's latest WP transition (same single status read); a re-approval after reopen requires acceptance again.

entries.question: Amend the finished-board ruling's 'remediation' wording to the next_command field
entries.rationale: Plan amendment (no behaviour change): Decision.remediation already means the materialization report (#7310 WP06), so the remedy command travels in the additive next_command field; error_code MISSION_AWAITING_ACCEPTANCE unchanged.

entries.question: Gate applicability by mission family
entries.rationale: Squad finding (arch B1): documentation/research DAGs have finalized boards plus post-WP steps (validate/publish/synthesis); per operator ruling 'research/custom unchanged', the gate applies only to mission_type software-dev, following the #3407 precedent (runtime_bridge.py:1006-1027).
